pages.title: Level 5
pages.text: Level 5 is the laboratory of Professor Monkey-For-A-Head in Earthworm Jim (Shiny Entertainment, 1994). Sega Retro calls it a "rather imaginatively titled" level. It ends with a boss fight against a chicken in a mech suit. VGMPF credits the music of this level to Keith Arem.

pages.title: Samples going off
pages.text: Tommy Tallarico, who is credited with the music of Earthworm Jim by many sites, told Sega-16 in 2005 that if you listen to the first two Earthworm Jim games, "you'll hear samples going off all the time". This tune is a good example, because it uses ten different sampled sounds, more than any other tune in the game.
